# __PROJECT_NAME__

> Launch your own Avalanche L1 with one command, then explore it in a built-in dashboard (live blocks, transactions, balance, contract deploy). Next.js + @avakit/react + viem + avalanche-cli, no third-party explorer.

Status: experimental. This template depends on Avalanche CLI, which has been in maintenance mode since December 2025, and it was last proven end to end in July 2026 (see "Tooling status" in README.md).

## Project map

- [scripts/l1.sh](scripts/l1.sh): `npm run l1` — create + deploy a local Subnet-EVM L1, write l1.config.json.
- [scripts/l1-fuji.sh](scripts/l1-fuji.sh): `FUJI_KEY=<key> npm run l1:fuji` — create a separate sovereign PoA config (`<name>fuji`, production defaults, owned by the Fuji key) and deploy it to the Fuji testnet (advanced). Never deploys the local dev config, never overwrites a config, safe to re-run.
- [l1.config.json](l1.config.json): your chain (name, token, evmChainId, rpcUrl, blockchainIdHex, faucetAccount).
- [lib/l1.ts](lib/l1.ts): config → AvaKit chain (`defineChain`) + `isConfigured`.
- [lib/deployed-contract.ts](lib/deployed-contract.ts): `useDeployedContract(name, chain)` — remembers the deployed demo token per chain instance (chain id + RPC URL) and only uses it once `eth_getCode` confirms bytecode, so an address from before a network reset is dropped.
- [components/demo.tsx](components/demo.tsx): the dashboard/explorer — polls RPC for blocks/txs/gas/balance, deploys + mints the demo token.
- [contracts/src/AvaKitToken.sol](contracts/src/AvaKitToken.sol) + [lib/token-artifact.ts](lib/token-artifact.ts): bundled ERC-20 for browser deploy.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent guide — the flow, an explainer for every L1 config decision, the EWOQ warning, and the Fuji graduation path.

## Key APIs

- Chain: `chain` and `isConfigured` from `@/lib/l1`.
- Explorer reads (all read-only viem): `getPublicClient(chain)` → `getBlockNumber()`, `getGasPrice()`, `getBlock({ blockNumber, includeTransactions: true })`, `getBalance({ address })`.
- Deploy: `deployContract({ artifact: { abi, bytecode }, chain, provider, account })` from `@avakit/core`.
- Write: `getWalletClient(chain, provider).writeContract({ address, abi, functionName: "mint", account })`.

## Config decisions

Subnet-EVM VM, EVM chain id (default 9999), native token symbol, `--sovereign=false` for a
zero-prompt local chain, `--test-defaults` (EWOQ pre-funded). The Fuji path uses a second config:
sovereign, `--proof-of-authority`, `--production-defaults` (no EWOQ; the owner address is pre-funded).

## Fuji CLI facts

- C-Chain → P-Chain: `avalanche key transfer --key <key> --fuji --c-chain-sender --p-chain-receiver --amount <x>`.
- Validator balance: `avalanche validator getBalance --fuji --l1 <name>` / `avalanche validator increaseBalance --fuji --l1 <name> --key <key> --balance <avax>`.
- Gas on the Fuji L1 is the L1's own token (not AVAX): the owner key and `subnet_<name>_airdrop` hold it.

## External docs

- Avalanche CLI (https://github.com/ava-labs/avalanche-cli) drives the local network. It has been in maintenance mode since December 2025; this template was last proven end to end with 1.9.6 in July 2026 (see "Tooling status" in README.md).
